title: The team, before launch
caption: The field crew with the Icebook before it went in. Names to add.

title: The block on the bank
caption: Icebook on the bank at the launch site, instrument housing on top, ready to go.

title: Launch
caption: In the water just above the Pioneers Boulevard bridge, 4:33 pm. Foam and woody debris on a turbid flow.

title: Under way
caption: Three seconds later, the block clears the snag and takes the current.

title: What the block saw first
caption: The onboard camera looks back at the crew on the bank, poles in hand, the bridge behind them.

title: Leaving the launch reach
caption: Nine minutes in. Fallen timber on the left bank, a crew member following along the shore.

title: Into the bend
caption: Nineteen minutes in and 280 meters downstream. The bank steepens; the bridge is still visible behind.

title: Under the trees
caption: Bare cottonwoods overhead at 350 meters. The creek narrows and the block speeds up.

title: The west bend
caption: The westernmost point of the drift, 620 meters along. A slumped bank and grass to the waterline.

title: The slow water
caption: The block enters a slow stretch: the next five frames cover eighty meters in four minutes.

title: Drifting
caption: Grassy bank, gray sky. The camera sits a few centimeters above the water.

title: Cutbank
caption: An eroding bank with exposed roots on the outside of the bend.

title: Still turning
caption: 775 meters along. The block rotates as it drifts, so the view swings from bank to bank.

title: Beneath a log
caption: A fallen trunk overhead as the block passes the bend.

title: Toward the take-out
caption: Rock and root along the bank at 844 meters.

title: Last frame from the water
caption: The final picked frame, 881 meters along and seven minutes before the trip log ends. Haze on the lens by now.

title: Recovery
caption: Out of the water and on the bench, 5:29 pm, 40 meters from the end of the track. 393 fixes, 250 photos, 0.59 miles.
